## 3700 - 3799

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03700">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3700 GQA - Low 26# RVP</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03700">

This exception is generated when a source’s 26# GPM quantity exceeds the user defined limit for minimum value for 26# GPM. For example, the minimum limit for 26# GPM is set to 0.0300, but the 26# GPM on the sample is imported at 0.0201.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03719">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3719 GQA - High total mol%</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03719">

This exception is generated when a source’s Total Mole % value exceeds the user-defined limit for maximum value for Total Mole %. For example: The maximum limit for Total Mole % is set to 100.000, but the Total Mole % on the sample is imported at 100.001.

This exception is also generated if sample normalization is enabled in GQ source validations. If the total mole % is higher than the normalization limit, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03720">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03720">

This exception is generated, and normalization is not performed, when a source’s total mole % value is less than the minimum normalization limit for the source.

</div>
